goal: Allow wallet logging to use standard severity levels while retaining wallet name prefixes
Make source location logging point to actual call sites instead of an inline helper
reviewability: PR sits on top of open PRs #29256 and #34778
agreement: Substantive support after lifetime safety and log level concerns were resolved (adyshimony)
Objection to using fatal log levels for wallet errors resolved by dropping commit (maflcko)
